summary.intent: Commit completed work including e2e tests and documentation changes to the repository.
summary.outcome: The e2e commit was successfully created and signed. The docs commit was initially interrupted by a backgrounded 1Password signing prompt but was subsequently committed successfully with all commits verified as signed.

workflow: 1Password SSH/GPG signing prompts can interrupt backgrounded git commit commands, requiring a follow-up commit attempt for any remaining staged changes.
Checking commit state after a backgrounded command is necessary to determine which commits landed and which were cut off.

friction: 1Password signing prompt caused the docs commit to be cut off when the commit command was backgrounded, requiring a second commit attempt.
